items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Cash on delivery, bKash, Nagad and major cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex). This preview build does not take real payments.

items.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
items.answer: Contact us within 2 hours of placing your order and we will do our best to change or cancel it before it ships.

items.question: Do prices include VAT?
items.answer: Yes. All prices shown are in taka (৳) and include VAT.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Usually 2–3 working days inside Dhaka and 3–5 working days elsewhere in Bangladesh.

items.question: How much is delivery?
items.answer: ৳80 inside Dhaka and ৳130 outside Dhaka. Delivery is free on orders over ৳3,000.

items.question: How do I track my order?
items.answer: Use the Track order page with your order number and the phone number or email used at checkout.

items.question: What is your exchange policy?
items.answer: Unworn items with tags can be exchanged within 7 days of delivery. See our refund policy for details.

items.question: What if my item is faulty?
items.answer: Contact us with a photo and your order number and we will arrange a replacement or a refund.

items.question: How do I find my size?
items.answer: Every product page has a size chart with measurements in centimetres and inches, plus a guide to measuring yourself. You can also visit our Size guide page.

items.question: How should I wash linen?
items.answer: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle, skip the tumble dryer and iron while slightly damp. Linen softens beautifully with every wash.
